name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, February 05, 2019 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive full reading of resolutions and ordinances and that they be read in title only.
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting held on January 15, 2019.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Amendment No. 1 to an Agreement for Managed Services - Information Technology with Numa
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 to an agreement with Numa Networks to: 1) Implement the City's server replacement project including migration of the mail server
for Office 365; 2) Provide on-site IT support services; and 3) Approve a budget amendment for the Server Replacement Project of $25,833.57 (which includes a $10,000 contingency) in addition to the previously approved budgeted amount and a budget transfer of $18,000 for on-site IT support for the remainder of FY 18-19.
Item #7d
e.
Amendment of a Professional Services Agreement with Waterworks Technology, Inc. and ratification of prior expenses
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to: 1) Execute an amendment with Waterworks Technology, Inc., for the period July 1, 2018 through June 10, 2019 for an amount not-to-exceed $28,332 for on-call water production and distribution operator staffing for a year; and 2) Retroactively authorize payments for fiscal years 2015-16, 2016-17 and 2017-18 in the amount of $42,382.
Item #7e
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE START TIME OF REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
ORD 800 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LOMITA APPROVING CODE AMENDMENT 2019-01 TO AMEND SECTION 2-1.01 OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE CHANGING THE STARTING TIME OF REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS FROM 6:30 P.M. TO 6:00 P.M. AND FINDING THIS EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT
(First Reading)
Sch #8
9.
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE CITY TO APPLY FOR FUNDING THROUGH THE WATER REPLENISHMENT DISTRICT OF SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA
Presented by Carla Dillon, P.E., Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the City Council adopt the attached resolution authorizing the City to apply for loan funding from the Water Replenishment District for the construction of the Granular Activated Carbon Filtration System and related upgrades to the Cypress Water Production Facility.
Sch #9
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, February 19, 2019, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall lobby bulletin board and posted on the City’s website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
